i1.title: Mercedes-Benz Man Eau de Toilette 20ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Clean, confident and easy to wear every day.

Mercedes-Benz Man Eau de Toilette 20ml is a woody aromatic fragrance for men, created by perfumer Olivier Cresp. Juicy pear and ambrette seed open fresh and smooth, a heart of cedar leaf and geranium adds an aromatic green character, and it settles onto a refined base of oakmoss and rosewood. The 20ml size is ideal for travel or your gym bag.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Pear, Ambrette Seed
  • Heart: Cedar Leaf, Geranium
  • Base: Oakmoss, Rosewood

Key details

  • Brand: Mercedes-Benz
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 20ml
  • Scent profile: Woody · Aromatic
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A fresh pear and ambrette opening
  • An aromatic cedar leaf and geranium heart
  • A refined oakmoss and rosewood base
  • Handy 20ml travel-size Eau de Toilette

FAQ

What does Mercedes-Benz Man smell like?

Pear and ambrette seed first, then cedar leaf and geranium, finishing with oakmoss and rosewood.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.

seo.title: Mercedes-Benz Man Eau de Toilette 20ml
seo.description: Mercedes-Benz Man Eau de Toilette 20ml: pear and ambrette over cedar leaf and oakmoss. Free UK delivery over £40.
